# R2.16 — Eval engine residual ops + fault battery

Ticket `docs/tickets/122_R2.16__eval-residual-battery.md`
(seq 122). Stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-r2.15` (PR #122);
ADR-0348. Offline-only: every cell is `fixture`-verified — the fault
battery executes over the recorded `benchset/stage3_v1` corpus and
the judge checks fold over declared run facts; no live model, judge,
HAL provider or foreign benchmark was contacted, and none is
claimed.

**Requirement ids:** DF-S1.22-1 · DF-S1.22-2 · BL-25 · OQ-377 ·
R-2.9.2.

## What landed

**`search_budget = unknown` — first-class, product-level only
(DF-S1.22-2; ADR-0348 D1).** `hh_budget::matchspec::validate_match`
delegates to `validate_match_at(arms, Granularity)`: at
`ProductLevel` an arm may carry `search_budget = unknown` — cap and
metering cross-checks skip the unknown-search arm (never coerced to
a zero — T-LCD-07) while enforcement checks still bind it; at
`ConfigurationLevel` (the default) it refuses `UnbudgetedArm`, and
M3 `matched_total` refuses it at any granularity. `CompareInput`
carries the granularity; `BudgetMatch.search_unknown` records the
flag on the report (serialized only when `true` — old reports
decode unchanged). At the spec layer `check_arms` admits the
absence only on an arm assigning a `hosted`-class level and
`check_match` picks each comparand group's granularity by the same
predicate; the `lab.eval.compare` boundary decodes `granularity`
and promotes `native: false` arms to hosted enforcement with the
unknown search budget.

**`declare_arm`'s last engine precondition (DF-S1.22-1; D2).**
`ArmConfiguration.budget_ref` (additive member naming the sealed
configuration's `budget_vector` semantic id) is checked at
`expand`: a mismatch against `arm.eval_budget` refuses
`ExperimentRefusal::BudgetMismatchWithinArm` (refusal code
`"BudgetMismatchWithinArm"`), never a dropped cell. `None` defers
to the record-level `Arm::validate` gate.

**Runtime judge-context derivation (DF-S1.22-1; D3).**
`hh_eval::judge::judge_context_for(run, independence)` derives the
`JudgeContext` from an `EvalRun` + its declared
`IndependenceVector` — the snapshot axis folds from the run's own
facts, an unbound judge refuses `JudgeError::UnboundJudge`;
`recheck_judged` re-admits at the consume side; the calibration-
expiry fold is the deterministic rule replayed over run facts
(ADR-0047(c), machine-achievable half).

**HAL `FaultType` levels (DF-S1.22-2; D4).** The seven spec-named
provider-side failure modes are first-class variants
(`timeout`/`error_response`/`partial_failure`/`rate_limit`/
`network_error`/`invalid_response`/`empty_response`) with
`f/hal-*-pNN` profiles in `stage3_fault_profiles()` bound at
`at: "provider_call"` — the same injection surface as every other
fault profile.

**OQ-377 interim rule (D5).** A foreign lift mints **no**
experiment binding — `subject.experiment` is empty on the lifted
manifest, the import record names none, and such rows stay
`undisclosed` under the leaderboard's `require_experiment` L6 gate
(AC-R-2.10.5-8). Pinned by
`hh-bundle/tests/s4_2.rs::foreign_import_mints_no_experiment_binding`;
the question itself stays OPEN (minting `provenance = imported`
runs is a later-ticket call).
